name: trust-strip
description: A monochrome trust row of wide-tracked mono wordmarks that fade in with an opacity-only left-to-right stagger, then hold dead still.

vars.description: Mark color: quiet muted or full-contrast ink.
Comma-separated reveal starts in seconds from mount start. Empty uses the authored 0.15s stagger.
Faint palette tint mixed into the mark color.
End-of-clip behavior. None holds to the last frame.
